Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1Text: Senda ("we" or "the platform") is the data controller for the personal data it collects through universosenda.com. This platform operates from Argentina and this policy is written to comply with Argentine data-protection law. For any question about this policy, write to us at hola@universosenda.com.
Privacy.section2Text: This policy is governed by Argentine Law No. 25,326 on the Protection of Personal Data, its regulatory Decree No. 1558/2001, and the rules issued by the Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública (AAIP), the Argentine data-protection authority. We also take into account, where relevant, Argentine Consumer Protection Law No. 24,240 and the Civil and Commercial Code of Argentina.
Privacy.section3Text: We collect the data you choose to provide us: name, email address, phone number, and message. If you create an account, we also process your display name, an optional profile photo, and the data from questionnaires you complete. For the Career Anchors Test, this includes the email address associated with your Google account, the 40 individual responses, the three final selections, optional career stage, ranking across all eight anchors, their scores, and the guidance-oriented feedback. We additionally collect technical data necessary for the site's operation and security, such as IP address, browser type, and pages visited.
Privacy.section4Title: 4. Purpose and legal basis of processing
Privacy.section4Text: We use your data to answer inquiries, provide requested services, manage your account, protect the single attempt, save progress, calculate and retain the result, protect the platform against abuse, improve its operation, and comply with legal obligations. The legal basis is your free, express, and informed consent (arts. 5 and 11 of Law 25,326), which you may withdraw at any time without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing. We do not use your responses or results to send marketing messages without express authorization, and we do not carry out unsolicited telemarketing; we respect Argentina's "Do Not Call" National Registry (Law 26,951) where applicable.
Privacy.section5Text: The Career Anchors Test requires a Google account to protect the single attempt and save progress. Responses are stored progressively, and the server calculates the ranking deterministically. To enrich the interpretation, the artificial-intelligence provider receives only the ranking, optional career stage, and language; it does not receive individual responses, name, email address, phone number, or location. If that service is unavailable, deterministic guidance-oriented feedback is used. The result remains protected in your account, and the notification email sent to you contains no responses or results. Results are for orientation only: they are not a clinical diagnosis and do not replace guidance from a qualified professional.
Privacy.section6Text: We retain your data for as long as necessary for the purposes described and while we have an ongoing relationship with you, for example while your account remains active, and afterward for as long as required by legal, accounting, or claims-defense obligations. You may request early deletion of your data at any time, subject to legal exceptions.
Privacy.section7Title: 7. Third parties, providers and international data transfer
Privacy.section7Text: To operate the platform we work with infrastructure, hosting, authentication, artificial-intelligence, and email providers. These providers may process data on servers located outside Argentina; where applicable, we apply the safeguards required by art. 12 of Law 25,326. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for commercial or advertising purposes.
Privacy.section8Text: We apply authentication controls, database permissions, server-side validation, protection against abusive automation, and encrypted communications, consistent with art. 9 of Law 25,326. No system offers absolute security, but we limit access to and collection of data to what is strictly necessary to operate the service.
Privacy.section9Title: 9. Your rights (access, rectification, updating and deletion)
Privacy.section9Text: As the owner of your data, you have the right to request, at any time and free of charge, access to your data, its rectification, updating, or deletion, as well as to withdraw your consent and to ask about any data disclosures we have made, in line with art. 14 of Law 25,326. To exercise these rights, write to hola@universosenda.com stating your name and the right you wish to exercise; we will respond within the applicable legal deadlines.
Privacy.section10Text: The Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública (AAIP), the supervisory authority for Law No. 25,326, is responsible for enforcing this law in Argentina. If you believe your rights have not been addressed, you may file a complaint with the AAIP (www.argentina.gob.ar/aaip).
Privacy.section11Text: We use essential cookies for authentication, security, and preferences, such as language or visual theme. Any non-essential technologies introduced in the future will respect the choice shown on the site. Senda is intended for people over 18 years old, and we do not knowingly collect data from minors. If you become aware that a minor provided us with personal data without appropriate authorization, please contact us so we can delete it.
Privacy.section12Title: 12. Changes to this policy and contact
Privacy.section12Text: We may update this policy to reflect regulatory changes or changes to our services; we will publish the current version, with its update date, on this same page. For questions about this policy, email us at <email>hola@universosenda.com</email>.

Terms.title: Terms and Conditions
Terms.section1Text: By accessing or using the Senda platform (universosenda.com) you accept these Terms and Conditions and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the site.
Terms.section2Text: Senda is a professional-support and career-transitions platform. It combines psychometric tools, editorial content, artificial intelligence as a copilot, and human support. The artificial intelligence and questionnaires offer reflective guidance: they do not replace Senda's human team, do not constitute a clinical, psychological, or psychiatric diagnosis, and do not guarantee specific career outcomes.
Terms.section3Title: 3. Registration, account and accuracy of your data
Terms.section3Text: Accessing certain features requires creating an account with truthful, accurate, and up-to-date information. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for all activity carried out from your account. The service is intended for people over 18 years old; by registering, you declare that you meet this requirement.
Terms.section4Text: You agree to use the platform in good faith and in accordance with the law, refraining from impersonating third parties, attempting to breach the site's security or access other people's data, using automated systems to scrape content without authorization, or using the service for unlawful purposes or purposes contrary to public order or morals.
Terms.section5Text: Assessments and guidance tools, including the Career Anchors Test, invite reflection and can be complemented by an individual conversation; they are not fixed definitions and do not, by themselves, determine study or career decisions. The free Career Anchors Test can be completed once per account; this limit is also enforced server-side.
Terms.section6Title: 6. Engagement, payments and right of withdrawal
Terms.section6Text: Before a paid engagement begins, Senda clearly and privately communicates its engagement terms, price, and available payment methods, consistent with the duty of information under art. 4 of Argentine Consumer Protection Law No. 24,240. No process is confirmed without your explicit acceptance. For contracts entered into remotely, you have the right to withdraw your acceptance within ten (10) calendar days of contracting, without any liability, consistent with art. 34 of Law 24,240 and Argentina's applicable rules on the right of withdrawal for distance contracting.
Terms.section7Text: Sessions may be canceled or rescheduled at least 24 hours in advance at no cost. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are nonrefundable. Session packages are nonrefundable once the process has begun, without prejudice to the right of withdrawal described above where applicable.
Terms.section8Text: All platform content, including text, designs, methodology, assessments, and session materials, is the property of Senda and is protected by applicable intellectual property laws. Reproduction, distribution, or commercial use without express authorization is prohibited.
Terms.section9Text: Senda does not guarantee specific results from using its services; our role is to provide tools, information, and guidance for each professional transition. Career decisions always remain the responsibility of each individual. This limitation does not exclude or restrict liabilities that, under Law 24,240 and the Civil and Commercial Code of Argentina, are non-waivable for consumers.
Terms.section10Title: 10. Governing law, jurisdiction and consumer protection
Terms.section10Text: These terms are governed by the laws of Argentina. For consumer relationships, and consistent with art. 36 of Law 24,240, the competent jurisdiction is that of the consumer's domicile, without prejudice to your right to pursue consumer dispute-resolution channels, such as COPREC or your local consumer-protection authority, before any judicial action.

CareerQuiz.metadataDescription: Explore, through 40 statements, which motivations carry the most weight in your career right now using Edgar Schein's Career Anchors model.
CareerQuiz.introBadge: Career Anchors Test · 40 statements · Edgar Schein's model
CareerQuiz.introTitle: The motivations behind your career decisions
CareerQuiz.introSubtitle: An inner compass for understanding your journey more clearly.
CareerQuiz.introParagraph1: Edgar Schein developed this model to explore the combination of abilities, motivations, and values that a person seeks to preserve throughout their working life.
CareerQuiz.introParagraph2: Career anchors bring together perceived capabilities, motivations, and values whose relative weight can shift with experience and context. Recognizing them can add perspective and help you notice what you need to protect during a time of change.
CareerQuiz.questionsScaleDesc: Answer each statement using the scale from 1 (Never) to 6 (Always)
CareerQuiz.transitionTitle: You are one step away from your results
CareerQuiz.transitionSubtitle: There is one final choice to help identify which aspects carry the most weight for you right now.
CareerQuiz.transitionInstruction: You'll review all 40 statements again. This time, choose the 3 affirmations that best represent what you need to preserve in your professional life, even as your role or context changes.
CareerQuiz.transitionNote: Your final three choices will carry additional weight in the calculation, helping us identify your primary anchor more clearly.
CareerQuiz.bonusSubtitle: All 40 statements are gathered here. Choose exactly 3 affirmations and review them before confirming.
CareerQuiz.bonusInstruction: Choose the 3 affirmations that matter most to you

CareerQuiz.prequizSubtitle: If you wish, you can add one optional detail about your current moment to contextualize the guidance.
CareerQuiz.resultsScheinQuote: A career anchor brings together the abilities, motivations, and values that a person seeks to preserve throughout their professional journey. — A summary of Edgar Schein's model
CareerQuiz.resultsDominantText: Because {article} {name} received the highest score, it may be a useful criterion to notice when comparing career options. Treat it as a snapshot of this moment and a starting point for reflection, not a fixed definition. If you'd like to explore it further, you can ask our team for guidance.

CareerQuiz.introLead: A guided pause through 40 statements to recognize which values, motivations, and capabilities carry the most weight when you choose, sustain, or change a job.
CareerQuiz.introProblemTitle: When a career decision does not quite add up
CareerQuiz.introProblemParagraph1: You may be facing a change, an opportunity, or a period of strain and still be unsure which criterion should guide your next step. Sometimes an option makes sense on paper but does not feel consistent with what you currently need from work.
CareerQuiz.introProblemParagraph2: This test helps you look beneath the immediate decision: what you seek to preserve, which conditions support your engagement, and which motivations deserve attention before you choose.
CareerQuiz.introTheoryText: Edgar Schein proposed career anchors as a way to explore the combination of perceived capabilities, motivations, and values that takes shape through professional experience. The model includes eight possible orientations, all of which may be present with different relative weight.
CareerQuiz.introTheoryClosing: The result does not put you in a box; it offers a map for asking better questions about your journey.
CareerQuiz.introBenefitsTitle: What can it help you understand?
CareerQuiz.introBenefitsLead: The interpretation offers practical criteria without turning them into a prescription.
CareerQuiz.introBenefit1Text: Recognize what supports your engagement beyond a job title or industry.
CareerQuiz.introBenefit2Text: Notice which environments help you use your capabilities more fully.
CareerQuiz.introBenefit3Text: Compare alternatives using priorities that are clearer and more personal.
CareerQuiz.introBenefit4Text: Identify which parts of your current experience may be receiving too little space.
CareerQuiz.introBenefit5Text: Turn your result into reflection and exploratory next steps.
CareerQuiz.introMomentTitle: A snapshot of your current professional moment
CareerQuiz.introMomentText: Answer from what you think and feel today. Priorities can shift with experience and context; this reading records the moment in which you complete it and remains available in your profile.
CareerQuiz.introOutcome1: A ranking of all eight anchors in the model.
CareerQuiz.introOutcome2: A detailed reading of the motivations with the greatest weight.
CareerQuiz.introOutcome3: Reflection questions connected to your result.
CareerQuiz.introOutcome4: An optional connection to your current professional situation.
CareerQuiz.introOutcome5: The option to revisit the result from your Senda profile.
CareerQuiz.introOneAttemptText: A free account can complete the test's 40 statements once. You may pause, resume, and review answers before confirming; afterward, the saved result remains available, but the test cannot be restarted.
CareerQuiz.introPrivacyText: Your responses and result remain protected in your account and are not published. To enrich the interpretation, the AI provider receives only the server-calculated ranking, optional career stage, and language—not your responses, name, or email address. If the service fails, deterministic guidance-oriented feedback is used.
CareerQuiz.introScopeText: There are no right or wrong answers. This is not an employment evaluation, does not measure performance or ability, is not a clinical diagnosis, and does not determine a profession, job, or decision. It is an orientation tool for gaining perspective, not for putting you in a box or replacing a conversation with a qualified professional when you need contextual guidance.

resultAnchorLens.technical: In this snapshot, deepening expertise, solving through a specialty, and continuing to build mastery seem to carry weight. When comparing options, notice how much room they offer to learn and use that knowledge, without assuming this excludes leadership or other interests.
resultAnchorLens.management: The wish to integrate perspectives, take responsibility, and influence broad decisions appears strongly. You can explore where that participation gives you energy and which form of leadership fits your current moment.
resultAnchorLens.autonomy: Having room to organize how you work and exercise your own judgment seems important today. Autonomy can take different forms—time, methods, or decisions—and coexist with collaboration and clear agreements.
resultAnchorLens.security: Predictability, continuity, and building on dependable foundations seem to have particular weight today. This does not imply standing still: it can help you identify the conditions that let you navigate change with sustainable safeguards.
resultAnchorLens.entrepreneurial: A motivation to create, put ideas into motion, and recognize your own imprint in what is built appears here. It does not require starting a business or taking a leap into uncertainty; it can emerge in an independent project or inside an organization that makes room for initiative.
resultAnchorLens.service: The connection between work, values, and contribution seems especially relevant. You can notice which kind of impact matters to you, for whom, and how you want it to inform decisions, without requiring every work experience to serve a single cause.
resultAnchorLens.challenge: Complex problems, novelty, and opportunities to test your abilities seem motivating today. It may help to distinguish the challenges that energize you from those that only add pressure or strain.
resultAnchorLens.lifestyle: The integration of work with other parts of your life appears as an important criterion. Instead of looking for one fixed formula for balance, you can explore which rhythms, boundaries, and degrees of flexibility make your current experience sustainable.

CareerAnchorIntro.metadataDescription: A test with 40 statements to understand which motivations influence your career decisions before deciding your next steps.
CareerAnchorIntro.label: Career Anchors Test · 40 statements
CareerAnchorIntro.title: The motivations behind your career decisions
CareerAnchorIntro.intro: Throughout a career, certain motivations can become especially important. They influence the challenges we pursue, the environments where we thrive, and the decisions we make when something needs to change.
CareerAnchorIntro.introContinuation: Through 40 statements, the Career Anchors Test helps you explore those motivations and better understand what you are looking for in your relationship with work today.
CareerAnchorIntro.benefit1: Recognize the motivations that carry the most weight in your professional life.
CareerAnchorIntro.benefit2: Understand which working conditions support your engagement.
CareerAnchorIntro.benefit3: Identify tensions between your current experience and what you are seeking.
CareerAnchorIntro.benefit4: Evaluate changes and opportunities with clearer criteria.
CareerAnchorIntro.benefit5: Open new questions about your career and your current stage.
CareerAnchorIntro.clarification: The result does not define a profession or determine a decision. It is a starting point for reflecting on your career, your motivations, and the possibilities you want to explore.
CareerAnchorIntro.accompanimentTitle: Would you prefer to explore your career and next steps with professional guidance?
CareerAnchorIntro.accompanimentDescription: If you are navigating a decision, a change, or a period of uncertainty, Senda's individual guidance offers a space to explore your motivations, revisit your career story, and build possible next steps.

development.title: Thinking about change through more than one voice.
development.paragraph1: Professional change is often framed around what the market demands: which profiles it seeks, which skills it values, or how we should position ourselves. Those questions matter, but they are not enough.
development.paragraph2: The Alternative Work Narratives Lab also pauses to explore another dimension: what appears when we look at our own path, which interests still feel alive, which experiences represent us, and which transformations can be built with greater coherence.
development.paragraph3: This is not about ignoring the realities of work, but about keeping them from becoming the only voice in a decision. Through exchange, reflection, and the exploration of new narratives, the Lab creates space to recognize what is genuinely ours and connect it with concrete possibilities.

meta.title: Who we are
meta.description: Who is part of Senda and why we accompany professional transitions.

hero.title: We accompany professional changes by putting the people going through them at the center.
hero.description: Senda is a space of support for people going through questions, changes, or transitions in their professional life.

origin.title: We come from a simple idea.
origin.paragraph1: Work takes up an important part of our lives, and when something changes, it's not enough to look only at a résumé, a role, or a job opportunity. Our interests, expectations, priorities, bonds, and ways of imagining what comes next change too.
origin.paragraph2: That's why we created a space to pause, gain perspective, revisit the journey so far, and open possibilities to choose how to continue.

outlook.title: Accompanying processes, not imposing answers.
outlook.paragraph1: We don't believe in a single professional path, or in answers that apply the same way to every person. Nor do we believe every change has to immediately become a complete overhaul, a new goal, or a demand to move forward.
principles: In making room for questions before looking for answers.
In understanding the journey before defining the next step.
outlook.paragraph2: We work with listening, judgment, and tools that let us approach each process from its own singularity, integrating the professional dimension with the person going through that moment. Accompanying a transformation means putting the person going through it at the center.

story.title: How do you accompany transformation processes while keeping the person going through them at the center?
story.paragraph1: Tania is a project consultant specialized in talent and transformation management, with more than fifteen years of experience accompanying people, teams, and organizations. Throughout her career she worked in talent management and development, and led and supported teams in science, technology, and education.
story.paragraph2: Thousands of interviews, working alongside professionals from different backgrounds, and the experience of accompanying individual and collective processes gradually shaped a question that now runs through Senda.
story.paragraph3: That question gave rise to the project and continues to guide how we work. Tania is now Senda's spokesperson: the person who communicates our outlook, brings forward the conversations we want to open about work and professional transitions, and coordinates the work of the professionals who are part of each process.

highlights.headline: Thousands of interviews
highlights.description: and processes tied to talent development

highlights.headline: People, teams, and organizations
highlights.description: going through processes of change and transformation

team.title: A team to accompany different processes.
team.paragraph1: Senda isn't built around a single professional perspective. We build our support by bringing together professionals with complementary backgrounds, tools, and perspectives, according to the traits and needs of each process.
team.paragraph2: A professional transition can involve questions about interests, professional identity, abilities, opportunities, positioning, employability, context, or next steps, and not all of those questions need the same answer or the same professional. That's why we want each person to find the support and tools that make sense for the moment they're going through.
team.premise: Our work as a team starts from one same premise: not to decide for the person, but to widen the possibilities they can choose from.

practice.title: Listening, perspective, and tools.
practice.paragraph1: Professional changes don't happen only in a résumé, a role, or an organization. They involve interests, expectations, journeys, bonds, questions, and ways of imagining what comes next. That's why we create spaces to gain perspective, revisit your own path, recognize what genuinely interests you today, and explore alternatives to choose how to move forward.
practice.paragraph2: It's not about pointing to a single path or offering ready-made answers. It's about accompanying each process with listening, perspective, and tools, respecting each person's timing, questions, and singularity.

senda.title: Opening possibilities to choose.
senda.paragraph1: A space born from years of work with talent, people, teams, and transformation processes. A team that understands there's a person behind every professional change.
senda.paragraph2: And a way of accompanying that aims to do something fundamental: open possibilities to choose.

choose.question: How do I know which proposal may support my moment?
choose.answer: The six proposals begin with different situations: exploring a direction, changing jobs, developing a project, thinking through leadership, resolving a focused challenge, or choosing education. If you are still unsure, the initial orientation helps identify a starting point without asking for personal data.

compass.question: Is Compass a test that tells me which degree to choose?
compass.answer: No. It includes exploration tools, but the process centers on conversation, researching alternatives, building criteria, and recognizing a direction of your own. No result decides for you.

newStage.question: What do the adult proposals have in common?
newStage.answer: They all connect the current situation with trajectory, identity, personal criteria, and context. The depth and tools change according to the question you need to work on.

format.question: Are meetings virtual or in person?
format.answer: Meetings take place online so you can sustain the process from wherever you are. Any available in-person alternative is discussed before you begin.

duration.question: How long does each journey take?
duration.answer: The duration depends on the journey and is discussed before you begin. The stages follow a clear sequence, with room to adapt them to each person's particular moment.

diagnostic.question: How does the initial orientation work?
diagnostic.answer: It is a brief, non-clinical questionnaire about your situation, what you need, and how urgent the change feels. The result appears immediately, without login or personal data, and does not replace a professional conversation.

results.question: What will I receive at the end?
results.answer: You finish with a personalized synthesis, decision criteria, and a roadmap. The specific materials depend on the journey and the work completed during the process.
